shortDescription: Manages load balancer pool members on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: address
options.description: The IP address to which traffic is sent.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Pool member will not receive traffic if false. Default is true.

options.name: load_balancer_pool
options.description: UUID of the load balancer pool.

options.name: monitor_port
options.description: The port to which health monitor checks are sent. If not specified, protocol_port will be used. Default is null.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the load balancer pool member. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.

options.name: protocol_port
options.description: The port to which actual traffic is sent.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the load balancer pool member.

options.name: subnet
options.description: The subnet of the address must be specified here.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the load balancer. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the load balancer. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.
